title: Bar Elnatan
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Eichah Rabbah, Petichta 23: “These are the doors of Nechushta bar Elnatan”; and in Kohelet Rabbah 12, on the verse “And the doors shall be shut”: “These are the doors of Nechushta beit Elnatan.” Hyman proposes a small correction in both: “Nechushta daughter of Elnatan,” who was the mother of Jehoiachin, as in II Kings 24, as cited in the glosses of the Radal there. Seder HaDorot, under the entry Elnatan, cites Rabbi Nechunya his son. Hyman distinguishes the two, for in Eduyot 6 it reads “Rabbi Nechunya ben Elinatan of Kefar HaBavli,” who was Rabbi Akiva’s colleague.

notes.text: The daughter-of-Elnatan correction and rejection of a connection to Nechunya are Hyman’s argument. Bar/beit/bat and Elinatan/Elnatan remain explicit; the heading is not a newly admitted male-sage identity.

II Kings 24:8 directly calls Nechushta the daughter of Elnatan and Jehoiachin’s mother. The consulted Mishnah names Nechunya ben Elinatan at Eduyot 6:2. A bounded Eichah Petichta 23 passage retains bar Elnatan; the exact Kohelet beit reading and Radal gloss remain Hyman’s reports, without admitting a male-sage identity.
